title: On the $p$-rationality of Deligne--Lusztig characters
summary: Among finite simple groups, character values of alternating and sporadic groups have relatively low irrationality at any prime $p$, whereas those of simple groups of Lie type can have arbitrarily high $p$-irrationality. We provide concrete evidence supporting this phenomenon.
